{{Quote|Some kind of darkness&hellip;settling over the city!|Beast Rider commander [[Gobee]], to Oron Kira|audio=SummonDarkness-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
When performed by an [[Sith sorcerer|individual]] adept in [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]], '''waves of darkness''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] conjured through [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] magic that created palpable waves of darkness&mdash;often visibly literal in their obscurity and accompanied by roaring, thunderous sounds. When exposed to waves of darkness, beings suffered from feelings of intense despair and confusion before feeling compelled, if detained under the spell's power long enough, to flee the scene of the disturbance.

In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the technique was used by sorceress-[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] against the [[Beast Riders]] and their [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]] during the [[Battle of Iziz|final battle]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Beast Wars]]. A later practitioner, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], used the power against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Computer, identify disturbance.''"<br />"''Wave force. Energy type unknown. Anomalous power surges detected.|A [[Sensor tower/Legends|sensor tower]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]], reporting its analysis of Amanoa's darkness spell to Oron Kira|audio=IzizBattleBeastWars5-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
Using ancient [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to summon waves of darkness required a [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]] to call upon the full scope of negative emotions that lingered in the center of their being. Fueled by the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], conjurers spewed forth their emotions in tides of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side energy]] that rapidly expanded in a spherical aura around them.<ref name="TOTJC" /> Waves of darkness manifested in the physical realm as well; affected beings noticed that the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] around them<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>&mdash;whether within the confines of a building<ref name="BWOO2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref> or outside in the skies above<ref name="JQ:TFS">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>&mdash;became thick with negative energy or visibly immersed in darkness. Thunder often boomed<ref name="TOTJA" /> and was accompanied by a roaring sound<ref name="BWOO2" /> as the darkness spread. Anyone caught in the vicinity might immediately begin to suffer also from feelings of intense horror, pain, and bewilderment. Victims were tormented by whispers of the dark side<ref name="JQ:TFS" /> that left them in a state of utter hopelessness, and prolonged exposure robbed them of the will to fight.<ref name="TOTJA" /> Dark-side waves caused [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other users of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] to feel stifled, as though their connection to the Force was being smothered.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

==Applications==
{{Quote|The battle is lost. Lost. Your strength is gone. Your will is gone. Your life is pain. Surrender.|The demoralizing whispers of Amanoa's summoned darkness|audio=TheBattleIsLost-TotJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
Waves of darkness were employed in battle by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sorcerers as a means of incapacitating the opposition. However, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] skilled in the art of Jedi [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] could nullify the debilitating effects of a darkness spell.<ref name="TOTJA" />

==Users==
===Queen Amanoa===
{{Quote|You want darkness, Oron Kira? I'll show you darkness!|Queen Amanoa, to Beast Lord Oron Kira|audio=Amanoa1-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
[[File:SummonDarkness.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The sky darkens under the power of Amanoa's spell.]]
[[Freedon Nadd]], an ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who once ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], was able to summon waves of darkness.<ref name="TOTJC" /> Nearly 400 years after Nadd's [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="BWOO2" /> in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the sorceress-[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] summoned darkness against the [[Beast Rider army|army]] of the [[Beast Riders]]&mdash;Onderonian dissidents led by [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]]&mdash;and their Jedi allies during the [[Battle of Iziz|final battle]] of Onderon's [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="BWOO2" /> Her foes were immediately beset with sensations of agony and dismay as the oppressive darkness rapidly expanded within the [[Iziz Royal Palace|royal palace]] of the Onderon [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. Outside, Kira's forces were overcome with feelings of severe pain and rendered incapable of fighting as the increasing darkness overtook them.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Kira, who had been previously unaffected, was suddenly stricken by the dark side's crushing power, which prompted the royal scribe [[Novar (Human)|Novar]] to join Amanoa's dark-side assault, effectively reinforcing its hold over Kira. It was only after the arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] and his implementation of battle meditation that the summoned darkness was lifted from the skies of Onderon.<ref name="TOTJA" /> Amanoa's use of waves of darkness against Kira's forces was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Chronology]]'', a historical chronicle compiled by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> and released in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TEC date note">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] establishes that the in-universe ''[[The Essential Chronology]]'' was published during the [[Osarian-Rhommamool conflict]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[25 ABY]].</ref> and [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']], a second edition of the chronicle released in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===Darth Tyranus===
{{Quote|Trespass don't we power Sith darkness command merciless ... Join us darkness conquer dominance glory ... You are blind and you are fools and understand nothing.|The dead Sith Lords casting their random-worded hisses of hate upon a dark-wave-assaulted Jedi coalition team in the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban|<ref name="JQ:TFS" />}}
[[File:DookuHS-SWILotS.png|thumb|right|200px|Darth Tyranus (pictured) was a practitioner of waves of darkness.]]
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Jedi Quest date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]'' to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].</ref> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="JQ:TFS" /> [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]],<ref name="TNEC" /> in alliance with the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban's]] [[Force ghost/Legends|dead]] Dark Lords, employed waves of [[dark energy]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] coalition team [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|sent]] to Korriban to track down galactic criminals [[Granta Omega]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. In the spaceport of [[Dreshdae]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], felt waves of darkness wash over and oppress them, followed by fleeting dark-side apparitions. Deep within the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple's]] long-abandoned [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], Kenobi experienced a darkness so thick and foreboding in its power that it seemed to invade his lungs, making it difficult to breathe.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

As the eight-member Jedi team entered the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], dark waves were assaulting them on all sides, the oppressive effects of which required great effort to wade through and overcome. The Jedi were afterward assaulted by dark-wave whispers, [[corpse vision]]s, and [[dark energy trap]]s amidst the tombs of the Sith Lords when they entered the Valley's ancient mausoleums.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Waves of darkness first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi 2|second issue]] of the first of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] story arcs to be released, [[1993]]'s [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon|''Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon'']]. The issue was written by [[Tom Veitch]], penciled by [[Chris Gossett]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="BWOO2" /> on [[November 16]], 1993.<ref name="DarkHorse">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54567/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_1993_2|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (1993) #2}}</ref>

In [[roleplaying game]] terms, using dark-side waves against another [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] player character automatically gives player characters a Dark Side point. Depending on the level of difficulty, the area of effect ranges from 1 to 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] for moderate, 3 to 10 meters for difficult, 11 to 20 meters for very difficult, and 21 to 30 meters for heroic.<ref name="TOTJC" />
